summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MIS Dashboard Working Capital feature. All 8 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified - Working Capital tab shows 4 summary cards (Initial WC, Loans, Repaid, Available), center-wise table, and loan activity timeline. Colors are muted/subtle as requested. MIS Overview tab and PDF/Excel exports still working.

working_capital_endpoint_structure.details: /api/mis/working-capital returns correct structure: initial_working_capital, total_loans, total_repaid, total_outstanding, available_working_capital, centers array, loan_timeline

working_capital_all_centers.details: All centers shows sum of franchise WC deposits: Initial ₹45L, Available ₹44.7L (after ₹30K outstanding)

working_capital_perth_loan.details: PB-PERTH shows loan entry: ₹50K loan, ₹20K repaid, ₹30K outstanding, ₹8.70L available (from ₹9L initial)

working_capital_not_cumulative.details: WC correctly calculated from franchise deposits minus outstanding loans, NOT from cumulative (Sales-Expenses-GST)

frontend_wc_summary_cards.details: 4 summary cards displayed: Initial Working Capital (₹45,00,000), Total Loans (₹50,000), Total Repaid (₹20,000), Available Working Capital (₹44,70,000)

frontend_wc_center_table.details: Center-wise Working Capital table shows PB-PERTH with franchise name, initial WC, loans, repaid, outstanding, available WC

frontend_loan_timeline.details: Loan Activity Timeline shows 2 entries: 2026-03-20 Loan (Equipment Purchase ₹50K), 2026-03-22 Repayment (+₹20K)

frontend_muted_colors.details: Colors are muted/subtle - loan amounts in orange-ish tone, repaid in teal/green, no bright green/red/yellow text

mis_overview_tab.details: Overview tab still works with 6 KPI cards, Sales vs Expenses chart, Sales by Center pie chart, Center Performance table

mis_pdf_export.details: /api/mis/download-pdf generates valid PDF (~192KB) with Working Capital section

mis_excel_export.details: Excel export includes Working Capital sheet with new structure (summary + centers + loan timeline)

international_center_currency.details: PB-PERTH (Australia) correctly shows $ currency symbol instead of ₹

critical_code_review_comments: Working capital endpoint correctly fetches initial WC from franchise records and loan entries from loan_entries collection
Available WC formula: Initial WC - Outstanding Loans (not cumulative sales-expenses-GST)
Frontend Working Capital tab has proper data-testid attributes: initial-wc, total-working-capital
Colors are muted using Tailwind classes like text-orange-300/80, text-teal-300/80 instead of bright colors
Backward compatibility maintained with 'data' and 'total_working_capital' fields in API response
seed_data_creation: None - used existing loan entry for PB-PERTH
